in_sanskrit.name: Manni
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Moon Goddess
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Manni एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Hindu mythology, Manni is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Mann’ which means ‘Moon’. Manni is considered a feminine form of the name, representing the gentle, nurturing, and calming influence of the Moon.
